name: ACCA
funding: Creative Victoria, Creative Australia and the City of Melbourne, plus the Ian Potter Foundation. Corporate partners include Dulux, KWM, Wood Marsh, Supernormal and Hannah St Hotel.

name: Monash University Museum of Art
funding: University-funded. The Besen family built the 2010 Caulfield premises. Schwartz Media is the media partner. Ian Potter Sculpture Court commissions. MUMA Contemporaries from $1,000.

name: Buku-Larrnggay Mulka Centre
funding: Small community art centre; core IVAIS support since 1998-99, plus NT Government, Ian Potter Foundation and Cotton On Foundation (retail).

name: Haus Wittgenstein (Bulgarian Cultural Institute)
funding: The Bulgarian state bought the house in 1975 and runs it as the Bulgarian Cultural Institute, the embassy's cultural department. Both countries' culture ministries backed its 2024 Wittgenstein exhibition.

name: Baku Museum of Modern Art
funding: Opened 20 Mar 2009 with about 800 works; founded by First Lady Mehriban Aliyeva and funded by the Heydar Aliyev Foundation, which she heads.

name: Military Trophy Park
funding: Azerbaijani state project. President Ilham Aliyev ordered it built in January 2021 and opened it on 12 April 2021, according to the presidential website.

name: RAK Art Foundation
funding: Private non-profit founded by Rashid Al Khalifa and housed in his family home with his collection.

name: Barbados Museum and Historical Society
funding: Annual Government of Barbados grant, plus memberships, gate takings, shop sales, ground rentals and consulting fees. The government appoints five of its 14 council members.

name: KX Space / Kryly Khalopa Theatre (Prastora KX, closed 2021)
funding: Art-sale auctions for the BYSOL solidarity fund were reported. Grant sources are not published.

name: Art-Belarus Gallery (Belgazprombank corporate collection)
funding: Belgazprombank started and runs the gallery and its corporate collection. Its Art-Minsk festival has run since 2018. Gazprom and Gazprombank own 49.8% each; Gazprom's chairman greets the project.
